project.title: CAPM Beta 回归
project.objective: 用散点和拟合线解释资产收益对市场收益的暴露

scenes.title: CAPM Beta 回归
scenes.subtitle: 用市场收益解释资产收益的系统性风险

formula.text: Rᵢ − Rf = α + βᵢ(Rm − Rf) + εᵢ

scenes.explanation: 斜率 β 表示资产对市场波动的敏感度。

captions.text: 每个点，是一次市场与资产收益的共同观测。
拟合线的斜率，就是资产承受系统性风险的 Beta。

timing_events.visual_action: title/subtitle reveal; axes establish return-return plane
timing_events.comfort_note: do not introduce formula before viewer sees the plane

timing_events.visual_action: teal observations fade in as a statistical cloud
timing_events.comfort_note: point opacity stays moderate so dots do not look like noisy particles

timing_events.visual_action: gold beta fit line draws through cloud; formula remains visible for pause
timing_events.comfort_note: line is the conclusion; keep final frame stable
